Package org.thewhitemage13.service

Class OrderStatisticService

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.service.OrderStatisticService
All Implemented Interfaces:
OrderStatisticServiceInterface
@Transactional @Service public class OrderStatisticService extends Object implements OrderStatisticServiceInterface
Service class for managing OrderStatistic entities.

This class provides methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting order statistics. It also supports retrieving all statistics and managing them by date.

Version:
1.0.0

  • Method Details

    • createOrderStatistic

      public void createOrderStatistic(org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Creates or updates an order statistic based on the provided OrderCreatedEvent.

      If a statistic already exists for the current date, it will be updated by incrementing the total number of orders, parcels in transit, and the total revenue. If no statistic exists for the current date, a new one will be created with initial values.

      Specified by:
      createOrderStatistic in interface OrderStatisticServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      orderCreatedEvent - the OrderCreatedEvent containing the details for the statistic update

    • updateOrderStatistic

      public void updateOrderStatistic(org.thewhitemage13.OrderCreatedEvent orderCreatedEvent)
      Updates the order statistic for the current date based on the provided OrderCreatedEvent.

      If a statistic already exists, the number of parcels in transit is decreased, and the number of packages received is increased. If no statistic exists, a new one is created with an initial value of 1 for packages received.

      Specified by:
      updateOrderStatistic in interface OrderStatisticServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      orderCreatedEvent - the OrderCreatedEvent containing the details for the statistic update

    • deleteOrderStatisticByDate

      public void deleteOrderStatisticByDate(LocalDate date)
      Deletes the OrderStatistic for the specified date.

      If no statistic exists for the given date, a StatisticsNotFoundException is thrown.

      Specified by:
      deleteOrderStatisticByDate in interface OrderStatisticServiceInterface
      Parameters:
      date - the date of the order statistic to be deleted
      Throws:
      StatisticsNotFoundException - if no statistic is found for the given date
